premises.text: Construction has been plagued with inefficiencies and productivity has stagnated
premises.evidence_span: Construction as an industry has been plagued with inefficiencies for decades. Productivity has stagnated.

premises.text: A significant amount of materials on job sites are wasted due to errors
premises.evidence_span: the vast majority of tasks are still managed on paper... result in almost 20% of materials on a given job site being completely wasted

premises.text: Recon Tools aims to create a connected ecosystem of hardware and software to reduce errors
premises.evidence_span: Recon Tools has set out to create a connected ecosystem of hardware and software products to significantly reduce these errors and streamline operations on the job site.

premises.text: The Rock job site app streamlines measurement operations and data collection
premises.evidence_span: the core of the Recon platform is the Rock job site app... allows everything from measurement capture, automatic putting into calculators, utilities, and other common actions

premises.text: Digital measuring tools should be as common on job sites as traditional tools like tape measures
premises.evidence_span: to make digital measuring tools as synonymous to a job site as a drill or a hammer.

premises.text: Recon Tools provides tools that are accessible to all workers on the job site
premises.evidence_span: this is something that everyone down to the individual electrician or plumber is using on the job site

value.text: Construction processes become more efficient and less wasteful through digital tools
value.evidence_span: it's time we demand more from our contractors and stop expecting errors, cost overruns, and timeline delays as inevitable.

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics included.
